title: commandlog
description: Append-only log of every (non-dev) command invocation. Written from src/log/index.js when ENV=prod. Stored as a MongoDB time-series collection (system.buckets.commandlog backs it).

sentDate.description: When the message hit the server

channelId.description: Channel Twitch user id (null for whispers)

command.description: Resolved command name (canonical, not the alias used)

custom.description: True when the invocation matched a customcommands entry

response.description: What the bot replied (null when there was no reply)

notes.description: Extra annotations attached to the message by handlers
